message.Title: Announcing: Extended Support for Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server

Body.Content:
Extended Support for Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server helps you maintain secure, supported workloads while transitioning to newer PostgreSQL versions. With access to critical security updates, critical bug fixes, and technical support for eligible versions after community support ends, you can upgrade on your timeline with greater flexibility and confidence. 

Learn more.
